subject: general
question: Who was the President of International Olympic Committee (IOC) till 30th September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thomas Bach.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Thomas Bach was elected as the **ninth President **of the International Olympic Committee on **10th September 2013**. He was re-elected for a **second four-year term on 10th March 2021.**
 
• The 67-year-old German received 93 yes and 1 no votes from the 94 valid votes.
 
• He served as IOC Vice-President from 2000 to 2004, 2006 to 2010 and from 2010 until his election as IOC President in September 2013.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• International Olympic Committee is a **non-profit independent international organization **founded in the year 1894.
 
• Based in **Lausanne, Switzerland,** the Olympic Capital is entirely privately funded.
 
• The International Olympic Committee is the patron of the Olympic Games and the leader of the Olympic Movement.
